desc:
💥 Smash, launch and blast ragdoll dummies with real physics! 💥

🔫 68 weapons: guns, melee, explosives, weather and silly toys
🔧 Gunsmith: scopes, lasers, grips and bigger mags
🗺️ 8 maps full of cannons, catapults, wrecking balls and traps
🚗 Drive cars, a tank and a crane
💣 Call in a Nuke, Dummy Rain or a Zombie Outbreak
🧱 Sandbox mode: spawn props and build your own chaos
👥 Make the dummies look like your friends
🎮 Play solo or start your own server with friends
🎁 Daily rewards, playtime rewards and quests
⭐ Level up to 100 and earn Bolts

🎁 Join Bad Physics Studios for a FREE BANKSHOT + 500 Bolts!
👍 Having fun? Like and favorite the game!

📱💻🎮 Play on phone, PC and console
